faqs.question: Why take FISH for Aneuploidy in POC - Chromosomes - 13,16,18, 21, 22, X and Y Test?
Is this test for you?
faqs.answer: This test is done on POC (abortous tissue) samples to evaluate cause (genetic) of miscarriage.

faqs.question: More Info on FISH for Aneuploidy in POC - Chromosomes - 13,16,18, 21, 22, X and Y Test
faqs.answer: Helps understand genetic results better, asses recurrence risk and plan for future pregnancies and preventive measures.
